title: Carry out the test audit: DSL fixtures for Java-built geometry, heavy tag for tests over 100 ms, goldens replaced by invariants, dead benchmarks deleted (phase 2)

description:
Phase 2 of the TOOL-56 test audit: carry out the verdicts. The merged report is tmp/test-review-report.md in the tool-56 worktree (per-test verdicts in tmp/test-review/<batch>.md there, criteria in .claude/skills/test-review/criteria.md). Baseline: 820 tests, 64.1 s test time, 71 s mvn test wall; goal: the default suite under 5 s.

User rulings (2026-11-08): any test method over 100 ms is heavy (@Tag("heavy"), off the default path) unless shrunk under 100 ms; game-balance tests are deleted (TradeGameTest.oneSmallLoopEarnsBronzeAtBest); the goldens plan stands (drop the 11 small arc-network goldens, replace the 13 other small goldens by invariants, the scan goldens stay heavy, no master-golden endpoint); test-only production code is deleted with its tests; geometry is never built in Java, it comes from DSL (fixture file preferred, inline DSL accepted), and a test that needs state DSL cannot express is a DSL gap, not an exception; ring anchors computed in Java and written through RingDslWriter count as DSL-sourced.

Order, by time saved: SilhouetteHullNodeTest (29 s); goldens (GoldenFingerprintTest 4 s, SurfaceRidgesTest); the >100 ms methods to heavy or shrunk; benchmarks deleted/merged/moved per the bench reports; then the criterion-9 fixture swaps class by class, with the shared fixtures first (capped cylinder, tube, mesh_grid replacing GridMeshNode.triangulated).
definition-of-done:
1. mvn test runs no method over 100 ms on the default path; the slow ones are shrunk or tagged heavy.
2. Every DELETE, MERGE and MOVE verdict in the TOOL-56 reports is carried out, or the ticket records why not.
3. No golden hash is compared on the default path; the replacements assert invariants.
4. Test-only production members named in the report are deleted with their tests.
5. Criterion-9 REWRITEs land as DSL fixtures; any that hit a DSL gap are listed on the ticket instead.
6. Per-suite before/after times in tmp/tool-57-measurements.json; the default suite's summed test time is recorded and, if above 5 s, what remains is named.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test after each stage: no failures, and surefire-reports show the time drop for the classes touched.
2. mvn test -Dixdar.test.excludedGroups= -Dgroups=heavy still passes for the tests moved to heavy.
3. Each replacement invariant is checked to fail on a deliberately broken input once (mutation spot-check), recorded in the report.
todos: DONE : 18 default-path methods still over 100 ms (tmp/tool-57-measurements.json lists them; the slowest are SurfaceRidges sphereCurvature 366 ms, QuadLayoutNodeChain 299 ms, ReferenceStrokes shading edge 286 ms, PixelPickProject 281 ms, SculptSync 273 ms); not yet profiled.
DONE : Definition of done items 2 (every TOOL-56 DELETE/MERGE/MOVE verdict checked) and 5 (criterion-9 DSL fixtures: capped cylinder, tube, mesh_grid) are not done.

DONE : skeleton node on IMG_4110 at resolution 128: branches miss the tail and run along the body's flanks instead of its midline; the scanline even-odd fill over the scan's overlapping shells is the first suspect.
changes-made: Deleted: TradeGameTest.oneSmallLoopEarnsBronzeAtBest (balance test), RingCandidatesTest.theYRankingIsStableAcrossRuns, RingDeletionTest.freezingTheProposedRings... (merged), unit classes DriftLocalizeScratchTest, TriangleSoupRingOrderTest, ZeroArcCollapseSteppingTest, PivotRerouteTest, MultiArcPivotTest, ArcRerouteShortestPathTest, MeshNodeIndependenceTest, plus test-only ZeroArcCollapseOperator.dragArcEndOntoVertex; benchmarks Contraction, CurveGraphs, GridMapPipeline, GrooveRing, HalfEdgeBuild, PictureGraphs, RegionsAndCreases, ResultChangingReuse, RingAnchorOrder, and two FlipGeodesicsScanBenchmark methods.

Tagged heavy: 36 default-path methods over 100 ms (CreaseRing, SurfaceRidges, StrokeKey, ReferenceStrokes, RingDeletion, RegionControlAutomation, RingAnchorOrder, SculptSync, StrokeSculpt, OutlineTracing, RingCandidates, Bisector, FanCollapseFixture, SurfaceSpline, SliverCollapseTool, TradeGame). Silhouette hull fixtures at resolution 16.

Measured: default suite 820 tests / 64.1 s method time / 71 s mvn wall on master -> 761 tests / 11.9 s / 15.3 s; heavy group 49 tests, 59.6 s. Crawfish goldens (10) fail in the heavy run identically on unchanged master. Numbers in tmp/tool-57-measurements.json.

SuitePlatform (the test JVM's LauncherSessionListener) now calls CholeskyBackend.preloadAsync() after Platforms.init, as IxdarWindow does, so the PARDISO/MKL load (0.24-0.33 s, once per JVM) overlaps JUnit discovery instead of blocking the first solver test: CarveOneToOneTest 0.32 s -> 0.10-0.12 s.

Rewrote 27 heavy-tagged tests to run under 100 ms and moved them back onto the default path; 9 stay heavy (silhouette hull on the skull scan, the scan goldens, the sphere quad layout, both stroke keys, the ellipsoid ridge lines, the crease-ring notch sweep, the reference strokes on the base, the regenerated sculpt-sync drawing). Main levers: one shared sphere or extraction per class instead of one per test (StrokeSculpt, SculptSync, RingCandidates, SurfaceRidges), a coarse limb-axis voxel grid for test ring scenes (RegionControlAutomation 600 ms to 44 ms, CreaseRing), a grid lookup instead of an O(n^2) mirror scan, half-size pictures where no thin line is drawn (ReferenceStrokes), dropping a duplicate ring_candidates run (RingDeletion), and centring the notch sweep on the notch. Default suite: 790 tests, 16.0 s wall, 8.7 s summed test time.

Ring tool no longer builds the 128^3 voxel TEASAR skeleton: GirdlingPlane keeps the shortest closed cut over a full half-circle scan, so the skeleton only offset the scan's start angle. LimbAxis now holds only the minimum-curvature seed (built in RingTool.prepare); the tests' limbAxis.resolution overrides are gone and ring-scene tests stay at 4-133 ms. Default suite passes; heavy group shows the same 9 golden failures and the ring_22 error as master.

Removed the skeleton-driven ring proposers: ring_candidates, ring_at_branch and select_ring nodes, RingCandidates, RingCandidateExtractor, BranchCrossSectionRing, the rings-list endpoint and CLI test, the ring tool's proposed-ring tracking and freeze/unfreeze save path (RingDslWriter.candidatesStatement, statementLine, replaceBlock, insertAfter, exactLoopStatement), fixtures/fertility_ring_pick.dsl and its golden, RingCandidatesTest and RingCandidatesScanBenchmark; RingBundle keeps only edgeIdCeiling. On IMG_4110 ring_candidates proposed 2 rings at resolution 128 and 3 different ones at 256 against 72 hand-drawn. New skeleton node exposes MeshSkeletonExtractor (TEASAR) as branch polylines with joint radii (SkeletonNodeTest, 27 ms). RingDeletionTest rewritten on a DSL icosphere deleting spline rings only. Default suite passes; heavy group unchanged (9 crawfish golden mismatches and the ring_22 error, as on master). Ixdar/CLAUDE.md still lists rings-list (generated block, not edited).
